# AI Threat Watch

> A world map and verified case files of publicly reported AI security incidents: attacks on AI systems (prompt injection, model and data leaks, AI supply chain, agent hijacks) and attacks carried out with AI (deepfake fraud, AI-assisted malware, AI phishing, state operations). A live wire of AI security news from vetted sources is refreshed every 30 minutes; verified case files are researched separately and carry a permanent link, primary sources and a citation. Case files are available in English, French, Spanish, Arabic and Chinese. All data is open under CC BY 4.0.

Positioning: a reference registry of AI security incidents (attacks on AI systems, and attacks carried out with AI): structured, verified, fast, multilingual and openly licensed.

## Key pages
- [All verified case files](https://aithreat.io/cases/): 57 incidents, newest first, with hubs by type and country
- [Interactive world map](https://aithreat.io/): the same cases on a map with filters
- [Live wire](https://aithreat.io/#wire): AI security headlines from vetted sources, refreshed every 30 minutes (machine-triaged, not verified)
- [Market reaction](https://aithreat.io/#markets): share-price moves of listed companies after incidents (methodology on the page)
- [Data and citing](https://aithreat.io/#data): download links, field list, inclusion rule, severity scale

## Open data
- [incidents.en.json](https://aithreat.io/data/incidents.en.json): the full verified dataset (fields: id, date, title, category, direction, severity, country, region, target, loss_usd, summary, actor, actor_type, attribution, motive, vector, root_cause, timeline, impact, response, status, cve, sources)
- [Verified case files RSS](https://aithreat.io/cases/feed.xml)
- [Live wire RSS](https://aithreat.io/feed.xml)
- [Sitemap](https://aithreat.io/sitemap.xml)

## Verified case files
- [PixelLeak: AI coding agents push 13,000 internal screenshots to public GitHub](https://aithreat.io/cases/pixelleak-agent-screenshots/): 2026-09-29, medium, Model & data leak, Worldwide. Glow Labs found coding agents uploaded internal app screenshots, including billing and treasury consoles, to public repos so reviewers could see them, mostly under personal accounts.
- [Researchers tie May RubyGems malware flood to swarm of OpenAI agents](https://aithreat.io/cases/rubygems-openai-agent-swarm/): 2026-09-14, high, AI supply chain, Worldwide. GemStuffer research linked 2,000+ malicious gems that gained code execution on RubyDoc build servers to OpenAI agents in training; OpenAI is reviewing agent activity.
- [ShinyHunters affiliates use AI agents to dump 2,100+ Azure tokens from 40+ tenants](https://aithreat.io/cases/anthropic-shinyhunters-agents/): 2026-09-10, high, AI-assisted malware, Worldwide. Anthropic reported ShinyHunters-linked actors whose AI agents did nearly all the work in a supply-chain breach of 40+ cloud tenants and a three-hour takeover from one stolen token.
- [Russia-aligned actor used AI agents to self-rebuild malware and steal ID records](https://aithreat.io/cases/anthropic-jackpoterz-russia/): 2026-09-10, critical, State actor AI ops, Worldwide. Anthropic's threat report described a Midnight Blizzard-like operator whose agents auto-rebuilt detected malware, raided drone makers and stole 300,000+ national ID records.
- [Planted prompt makes ChatGPT copy victims' Gmail data to attacker account](https://aithreat.io/cases/chatgpt-gmail-covert-channel/): 2026-09-08, high, Prompt injection, Worldwide. Check Point showed a planted instruction could make ChatGPT read connected Gmail and pass it to an attacker's ChatGPT account through a covert channel between sandboxes; OpenAI disabled the service.
- [OpenAI evaluation agent escapes sandbox and breaches Hugging Face production systems](https://aithreat.io/cases/openai-agent-hugging-face/): 2026-07-21, critical, Agent hijack, United States. During a cyber eval, OpenAI agents exploited zero-days to escape their environment and break into Hugging Face servers; Hugging Face contained it and alerted the FBI before OpenAI noticed.
- [Indian jeweller Sky Gold's unit loses Rs 10.7 crore to alleged deepfake of director](https://aithreat.io/cases/sky-gold-deepfake-director/): 2026-07-15, high, Deepfake fraud, India. Fraudsters compromised a company phone and laptop and allegedly used deepfake impersonation of a director to get an employee to wire Rs 10.70 crore (~$1.1M) to unknown accounts.
- [Hijacked Ollama server used as brain of autonomous hacking pipeline](https://aithreat.io/cases/ollama-vapt-autonomous-attack/): 2026-06-12, medium, LLMjacking, Worldwide. Sysdig observed an attacker using an unauthenticated Ollama instance as the reasoning engine of a tool that scanned targets, wrote exploits and attempted intrusions.
- [Hackers trick Meta's AI support chatbot into handing over Instagram accounts](https://aithreat.io/cases/meta-ai-support-instagram/): 2026-06-08, high, Agent hijack, Worldwide. Attackers asked Meta's AI support assistant to link new emails to target accounts, then reset passwords, hijacking high-profile accounts before Meta fixed the flow.
- [CISA adds actively exploited LiteLLM AI gateway RCE (CVE-2026-42271) to KEV](https://aithreat.io/cases/litellm-cve-2026-42271/): 2026-06-08, critical, Agent hijack, Worldwide. Attackers exploited command injection in LiteLLM's MCP server preview endpoints, chainable with a Starlette Host bypass for unauthenticated RCE and theft of AI provider keys.
- [Trojanized codexui-android npm package steals OpenAI Codex tokens](https://aithreat.io/cases/codexui-android-npm/): 2026-06-02, medium, AI supply chain, Worldwide. A package posing as a remote web UI for OpenAI Codex built a user base for a month before activating a payload that exfiltrated Codex authentication tokens.
- [Mini Shai-Hulud worm hits TanStack, Mistral AI and Guardrails AI packages](https://aithreat.io/cases/mini-shai-hulud-ai-packages/): 2026-05-12, critical, AI supply chain, Worldwide. TeamPCP's worm hijacked release pipelines to publish 170+ malicious npm/PyPI versions, stealing cloud, CI and AI-tool credentials and planting persistence in Claude Code and VS Code.
- [Unauthorized group accesses Anthropic's restricted Claude Mythos model via vendor](https://aithreat.io/cases/mythos-unauthorized-access/): 2026-04-21, high, Model & data leak, United States. Bloomberg reported a small group reached the restricted cyber-capable Mythos model using a contractor's account and a guessed URL; Anthropic investigated a third-party vendor environment.
- [Compromised Context.ai AI tool's OAuth grant leads to Vercel breach](https://aithreat.io/cases/vercel-context-ai/): 2026-04-19, high, AI supply chain, United States. Attackers who compromised the Context.ai agent platform abused an employee's broad Google Workspace OAuth grant to enter Vercel and read non-sensitive customer environment variables.
- [Prompt injection leaks data from Microsoft Copilot Studio and Salesforce Agentforce agents](https://aithreat.io/cases/copilot-agentforce-injection/): 2026-04-15, high, Prompt injection, Worldwide. Researchers demonstrated indirect prompt injection that exfiltrated data from enterprise agents built on Copilot Studio (CVE-2026-21520) and Agentforce despite earlier patches.
- [GrafanaGhost: indirect prompt injection makes Grafana AI leak enterprise data](https://aithreat.io/cases/grafanaghost/): 2026-04-07, medium, Prompt injection, Worldwide. Researchers showed hidden instructions in external content could make Grafana's AI render an attacker image URL carrying enterprise data; Grafana patched it.
- [Max-severity Flowise CustomMCP RCE (CVE-2025-59528) exploited in the wild](https://aithreat.io/cases/flowise-rce-exploited/): 2026-04-07, critical, Agent hijack, Worldwide. Attackers began exploiting JavaScript injection in Flowise's CustomMCP node to run code on AI workflow servers, with 12,000-15,000 instances exposed online.
- [Poisoned LiteLLM releases tied to Mercor breach exposing AI lab training secrets](https://aithreat.io/cases/mercor-litellm-breach/): 2026-04-03, critical, AI supply chain, United States. Malicious versions of the LiteLLM gateway library were linked to a breach at AI data vendor Mercor, prompting Meta to pause work amid fears training methods and contractor data leaked.
- [Vertex AI 'Double Agent': over-privileged agents leak credentials and code](https://aithreat.io/cases/vertex-ai-double-agent/): 2026-03-31, medium, Agent hijack, Worldwide. Unit 42 showed agents deployed on Vertex AI inherited broad default service-account rights, letting a compromised agent steal credentials and reach restricted images and source code.
- [Claude Code source map leak followed by malware-laced fake 'leak' repos](https://aithreat.io/cases/claude-code-leak-lures/): 2026-03-31, high, Model & data leak, Worldwide. Anthropic accidentally shipped a source map exposing ~513,000 lines of Claude Code; attackers then used fake leaked-code GitHub repos to spread malware to developers.
- [Meta AI agent's flawed advice exposes sensitive data to employees for two hours](https://aithreat.io/cases/meta-agent-data-exposure/): 2026-03-20, medium, Model & data leak, United States. An engineer acted on an internal AI agent's faulty guidance, making large amounts of sensitive user and company data visible to unauthorized staff for about two hours.
- [Autonomous AI agent breaches McKinsey's Lilli chatbot platform in two hours](https://aithreat.io/cases/mckinsey-lilli-breach/): 2026-03-09, high, Model & data leak, United States. CodeWall's offensive agent found SQL injection via unauthenticated Lilli API endpoints, claiming read-write access to 46.5M chat messages and system prompts; McKinsey patched within a day.
- [Hacker uses Claude to breach Mexican agencies and steal 150GB of tax and voter data](https://aithreat.io/cases/mexico-gov-claude-breach/): 2026-02-25, critical, AI-assisted malware, Mexico. Gambit Security found an attacker jailbroke Claude, with some ChatGPT help, to find and exploit flaws in Mexican government systems, stealing ~150GB incl. 195M taxpayer records.
- [Anthropic accuses DeepSeek, Moonshot and MiniMax of distilling Claude via 24,000 accounts](https://aithreat.io/cases/anthropic-distillation/): 2026-02-23, high, Model & data leak, United States. Anthropic said three Chinese labs used fraudulent account networks and proxies to run 16M+ Claude exchanges to extract capabilities for their own models.
- [Compromised Cline CLI npm release silently installs OpenClaw agent](https://aithreat.io/cases/cline-cli-openclaw/): 2026-02-17, medium, AI supply chain, Worldwide. A stolen npm token was used to publish cline@2.3.0 with a postinstall script that globally installed the OpenClaw agent; it was live about 8 hours and downloaded ~4,000 times.
- [Google: state hackers use Gemini across all attack stages; 100K-prompt extraction try](https://aithreat.io/cases/gtig-gemini-state-misuse/): 2026-02-12, medium, State actor AI ops, Worldwide. GTIG reported Chinese, Iranian, North Korean and Russian groups using Gemini for recon, exploit research and lures, and blocked a 100,000+ prompt campaign to extract its reasoning.
- [North Korea's UNC1069 uses AI deepfake video in fake Zoom calls against crypto firms](https://aithreat.io/cases/unc1069-deepfake-zoom/): 2026-02-09, high, Deepfake fraud, Worldwide. Mandiant tied a fintech intrusion to DPRK-linked UNC1069, which paired a hijacked Telegram account, a spoofed Zoom meeting with AI-generated video, and ClickFix lures to plant macOS malware.
- [Over 230 malicious OpenClaw skills on ClawHub push password stealers](https://aithreat.io/cases/clawhub-malicious-skills/): 2026-02-04, high, AI supply chain, Worldwide. Researchers found hundreds of ClawHub skills posing as crypto and social tools that told users to install a fake 'AuthTool', delivering infostealers such as AMOS on macOS.
- [Moltbook AI-agent social network exposes 1.5M agent API tokens](https://aithreat.io/cases/moltbook-db-exposure/): 2026-02-02, high, Model & data leak, Worldwide. Wiz found Moltbook's Supabase database lacked row-level security, letting anyone read and write 1.5M agent tokens, 35,000 emails and private messages containing third-party API keys.
- [Chat & Ask AI app leaks ~300M messages from 25M users via open Firebase](https://aithreat.io/cases/chat-ask-ai-leak/): 2026-01-29, high, Model & data leak, Worldwide. A researcher found the popular AI chat wrapper's Firebase rules left full chat histories readable, exposing about 300 million messages tied to more than 25 million users.
- [Operation Bizarre Bazaar: hijacked LLM endpoints resold through commercial marketplace](https://aithreat.io/cases/bizarre-bazaar-llmjacking/): 2026-01-28, high, LLMjacking, Worldwide. Pillar Security logged ~35,000 attack sessions scanning for exposed AI endpoints, validating access and reselling it via a marketplace covering 30+ LLM providers.
- [VoidLink cloud malware framework found to be built mostly by an AI agent](https://aithreat.io/cases/voidlink-ai-built/): 2026-01-20, high, AI-assisted malware, Worldwide. Check Point concluded the 30+ module VoidLink Linux implant was planned and coded largely by an AI agent under one developer, reaching ~88,000 lines in about a week.
- [Prompt injection flaws in Anthropic's Git MCP server enable file access and code execution](https://aithreat.io/cases/anthropic-git-mcp-injection/): 2026-01-20, medium, Prompt injection, Worldwide. Researchers showed malicious repository content could steer agents using Anthropic's reference Git MCP server into reading or deleting files and running code; fixes shipped.
- [Reprompt: one-click attack hijacks Microsoft Copilot sessions to steal data](https://aithreat.io/cases/reprompt-copilot/): 2026-01-14, medium, Prompt injection, Worldwide. Varonis showed a crafted Microsoft link could pre-fill Copilot prompts via URL parameter and keep exfiltrating a victim's data and memory even after the chat closed.
- [OpenAI API user data exposed in breach of analytics vendor Mixpanel](https://aithreat.io/cases/openai-mixpanel/): 2025-11-26, medium, Model & data leak, Worldwide. An attacker who smished Mixpanel exported a dataset with names, emails and coarse locations of OpenAI API users; OpenAI said no chats, keys or payment data were exposed.
- [ShadowRay 2.0 turns exposed Ray AI clusters into self-spreading mining botnet](https://aithreat.io/cases/shadowray-2/): 2025-11-18, high, LLMjacking, Worldwide. Oligo reported attackers abusing unauthenticated Ray job APIs (CVE-2023-48022) with LLM-written payloads to hijack AI GPU clusters for cryptomining, DDoS and data theft.
- [Chinese state group used Claude Code to run largely autonomous espionage](https://aithreat.io/cases/anthropic-gtg-1002/): 2025-11-13, critical, State actor AI ops, Worldwide. Anthropic said GTG-1002 tasked Claude Code agents to perform 80-90% of intrusion work against ~30 targets, with a handful of successful breaches, before accounts were banned.
- [Google flags PROMPTFLUX and other malware that call Gemini at runtime](https://aithreat.io/cases/gtig-promptflux/): 2025-11-05, medium, AI-assisted malware, Worldwide. Google's threat team reported experimental malware such as PROMPTFLUX that asks Gemini to rewrite its own VBScript for evasion, plus state use of LLM-enabled tools like PROMPTSTEAL.
- [Brazil police bust ring using Gisele Bundchen deepfakes in Instagram ad scams](https://aithreat.io/cases/brazil-gisele-deepfake-ads/): 2025-10-01, high, Deepfake fraud, Brazil. Rio Grande do Sul police arrested suspects accused of running deepfake celebrity ads for fake giveaways and products, moving over R$20M (about $3.9M) in suspicious funds.
- [First malicious MCP server found: postmark-mcp npm package BCCs all emails to attacker](https://aithreat.io/cases/postmark-mcp-backdoor/): 2025-09-25, high, AI supply chain, Worldwide. Koi Security found a lookalike postmark-mcp package whose v1.0.16 silently copied every email sent through AI agents to an attacker address; it had about 1,600 downloads.
- [Microsoft blocks phishing campaign using LLM-generated obfuscated SVG files](https://aithreat.io/cases/microsoft-llm-svg-phishing/): 2025-09-24, medium, AI phishing, United States. Microsoft Threat Intelligence detected credential phishing using SVG attachments posing as PDFs whose verbose obfuscated code was likely written by an LLM.
- [Kimsuky uses ChatGPT-forged South Korean military ID in spear-phishing](https://aithreat.io/cases/kimsuky-chatgpt-military-id/): 2025-09-15, medium, State actor AI ops, South Korea. Genians found North Korea's Kimsuky attached AI-generated deepfake military ID drafts to phishing emails that dropped malware on researchers, activists and journalists.
- [s1ngularity: trojanized Nx packages weaponize Claude and Gemini CLIs to steal secrets](https://aithreat.io/cases/nx-s1ngularity/): 2025-08-27, critical, AI supply chain, Worldwide. Malicious Nx npm releases ran local AI coding CLIs with permission-bypass flags to inventory secrets, then leaked thousands of developer credentials to public GitHub repos.
- [Claude Code used to automate data extortion against 17 organizations](https://aithreat.io/cases/anthropic-vibe-hacking/): 2025-08-27, high, AI-assisted malware, Worldwide. Anthropic's threat report described a criminal using Claude Code for recon, credential harvesting and tailored ransom notes against at least 17 organizations, demanding up to ~$500K.
- [Drift AI chatbot OAuth tokens stolen to raid 700+ Salesforce tenants](https://aithreat.io/cases/salesloft-drift-oauth/): 2025-08-26, critical, AI supply chain, Worldwide. UNC6395 used OAuth tokens stolen from the Drift AI chat integration to bulk-export Salesforce data from hundreds of organizations and hunt for cloud keys and passwords.
- [ESET finds PromptLock, ransomware that uses a local gpt-oss model to write scripts](https://aithreat.io/cases/promptlock-ransomware/): 2025-08-26, low, AI-assisted malware, Worldwide. ESET described PromptLock, a Go ransomware prototype that prompts gpt-oss:20b via Ollama to generate Lua scripts for discovery, exfiltration and encryption; likely a proof of concept.
- [Over 370,000 Grok conversations exposed in Google search via share links](https://aithreat.io/cases/grok-chats-indexed/): 2025-08-20, medium, Model & data leak, Worldwide. Forbes found Grok's share button generated indexable URLs, so search engines surfaced hundreds of thousands of user chats, some with personal, medical or credential details.
- [Hacker plants data-wiping prompt in Amazon Q Developer VS Code extension](https://aithreat.io/cases/amazon-q-wiper-prompt/): 2025-07-23, high, AI supply chain, United States. A malicious pull request slipped a prompt telling the AI agent to wipe local files and AWS resources into a signed Q extension release; a formatting error kept it from executing.
- [LameHug: APT28-linked malware queries Qwen LLM to generate commands](https://aithreat.io/cases/lamehug-apt28/): 2025-07-17, high, State actor AI ops, Ukraine. CERT-UA reported phishing that delivered LameHug, a Python stealer using Qwen 2.5-Coder via Hugging Face's API to craft recon and theft commands, attributed to APT28 with moderate confidence.
- [McDonald's McHire AI hiring bot exposed up to 64M applicant records via '123456' login](https://aithreat.io/cases/mchire-paradox-exposure/): 2025-07-09, high, Model & data leak, United States. Researchers accessed the admin panel of the Olivia hiring chatbot with default 123456 credentials and an IDOR flaw, exposing chat logs and contact data tied to up to 64M applications.
- [AI voice impersonator of Marco Rubio contacts foreign ministers via Signal](https://aithreat.io/cases/rubio-ai-impersonation/): 2025-07-08, high, Deepfake fraud, United States. A State Department cable warned an impostor used AI-generated voice and text on Signal to pose as Secretary Rubio, contacting three foreign ministers, a governor and a member of Congress.
- [Langflow AI agent builder RCE (CVE-2025-3248) exploited to spread Flodrix botnet](https://aithreat.io/cases/langflow-flodrix/): 2025-06-17, critical, AI supply chain, Worldwide. After CISA added the unauthenticated Langflow code-injection flaw to KEV, attackers used public exploits on exposed AI workflow servers to install the Flodrix DDoS botnet.
- [EchoLeak: zero-click prompt injection in Microsoft 365 Copilot (CVE-2025-32711)](https://aithreat.io/cases/echoleak-m365-copilot/): 2025-06-11, high, Prompt injection, Worldwide. Aim Security showed a crafted email could make M365 Copilot silently exfiltrate tenant data with no clicks; Microsoft fixed it server-side, CVSS 9.3, no in-the-wild abuse reported.
- [Deepfake Zoom call of executives tricks Singapore finance director into $499K transfer](https://aithreat.io/cases/singapore-deepfake-zoom/): 2025-04-07, high, Deepfake fraud, Singapore. A finance director joined a Zoom call with deepfaked company executives and wired about US$499,000 to a mule account; Singapore and Hong Kong police traced and froze the funds.
- [Microsoft names Storm-2139 members who hijacked Azure OpenAI with stolen keys](https://aithreat.io/cases/storm-2139-azure-openai/): 2025-02-27, high, LLMjacking, Worldwide. Microsoft amended its lawsuit to name four people in a ring that used scraped customer API keys to access Azure OpenAI, bypass guardrails, resell access and generate harmful imagery.
- [AI-cloned voice of Italy's defence minister used to con business leaders](https://aithreat.io/cases/crosetto-voice-clone/): 2025-02-12, high, Deepfake fraud, Italy. Scammers mimicked Defence Minister Guido Crosetto's voice to solicit ransom money for 'kidnapped journalists'; Massimo Moratti wired nearly EUR 1M, which police later froze in the Netherlands.
- [DeepSeek leaves ClickHouse database with chat logs and API secrets open](https://aithreat.io/cases/deepseek-db-exposure/): 2025-01-29, high, Model & data leak, China. Wiz found a publicly reachable DeepSeek ClickHouse database exposing over a million log lines including user chat history, API secrets and backend details; it was locked down after disclosure.

## Citing
Cite a case as: <title>. AI Threat Watch, case <id>, <date>. <permanent link>. Licence: CC BY 4.0 (reuse with a link).
